headline: Liberian Senate Demands Suspension of Port Cargo Operators Amid Congestion
summary: Liberia's Senate voted to suspend operations of MedTech Scientific and GTMS at the Freeport of Monrovia, citing excessive cargo fees, severe clearance delays, and port congestion.
why: Operational bottlenecks at the Freeport of Monrovia directly affect import supply chains and consumer price inflation in Liberia.

impacts.name: Liberia
impacts.why: Liberian lawmakers demanded suspending port operators over cargo backlog issues.
